meta.name: The Greatest Rivalry India vs Pakistan
meta.description: Tracing the cricketing rivalry between India and Pakistan, this documentary series explores their intricate past and uncertain present on the pitch.

videos.title: Rise of the Legends
videos.overview: With cricketing legends emerging from both countries, their clashes turn into the ultimate sporting spectacle, even as war and politics persist.

videos.title: The Battleground
videos.overview: In 2004, the Indian cricket team travels to Pakistan for the first time in 15 years for a historic ODI series that leaves the two nations spellbound.

videos.title: Making History
videos.overview: Heroes are forged as pressure builds during the series. The IPL heralds a new partnership between Indian and Pakistani players, until terror strikes.
